body_html:
I am very proud of this page. First pages I have taken from paper prototype and built myself because of #teachtheweb (while remixing html/css from a variety of sources). The link to the CV only works on my card but I will finish off everyone else's soon.

The one think I could not nail perfectly is my CSS positioning. I used floats so character count moves elements around. I need to think about fixed, absolute, and grid display. I want to get everything parallel. I only get 630px to work with (and they are defined) so things got way above my skill level.

Then again I am also faking it with web design and working way above my skill level.
